name: Assurance, Qualification and Appraisal System
responsibility: Evaluates exact-scope conformance, operational, security, performance, exit and vertical-acceptance evidence independently of compilation.

name: Authority and Judgment Adjudication Workbench
responsibility: Routes unresolved choices, exceptions and semantic disputes to named owners and records decisions with scope and evidence.

name: Constraint Planner and Synthesizer
responsibility: Enumerates and compares feasible candidates under declared hard constraints, objectives and finite budgets.

name: Desired-State Reconciler and Operators
responsibility: Interprets an authorized immutable blueprint, converges physical state, reconciles unknown effects and emits receipts.

name: Deterministic Compiler Kernel
responsibility: Transforms exact declarations through typed IR stages; checks legality, closure and reproducibility; emits a blueprint or typed residuals.

name: Open-World Ontology Research Extension
responsibility: Detects unknown concepts or absent boundaries, creates falsifiable research/adjudication packages and resumes synthesis only after governed extension.
